reviews.text: I have awesome news about LT Land and Tree service, their professional, hardworking team. I was very satisfied with 5 stump and multiple root removals. They even cleared area and leveled ground with top soil. Highly recommended!!
reviews.author: D A.

reviews.text: I had a large pine tree, and some brush that needed to be removed. I contacted Todd and was given a fair price for the work that needed to be completed. On the day the work was completed the crew showed up on time and completed the job in a efficient manner.
reviews.author: Kaylee K.

reviews.text: My go-to guys for tree service, prompt, fair pricing and they do a great job. Quick service in an emergency. And they clean up well.
reviews.author: kimberly P.
